S1 Walking skeleton: `factory run sc-NNNN` opens a PR on the sandbox repo
S2 Work-source interface + Shortcut adapter + intake polling
S3 Durable lifecycle state machine, ledger and crash resume
S4 Worker sandbox: dedicated macOS user and throwaway worktrees
S5 GitHub App: per-run scoped tokens and `factory/*` rulesets
S6 Session capture: stream-json persisted and pushed over SignalR
S7 Dashboard: login, pipeline view, live and replayed transcripts
S8 Controls: pause, continue and stop per item, epic or factory
S9a Router: expose subscription usage windows over HTTP
S9b Usage pause and resume at reset, with spend per item
S10 Terminal: epic acceptance tests, feature-end review, merge to main
